observations: In this run we observed the agent opening most later sessions by reading the package wholesale (ck3 step 3, ck7 step 3, ck8 steps 3-11) and adding new modules rather than editing existing ones; ck3 was the exception, rewriting output and formatter in place (ck3 steps 11, 13). Each session re-ran its own growing pytest suite and stated earlier tests still passed (ck2 step 24, ck4 step 20, ck7 step 24), but in ck8 it changed earlier tests to fit new first-run behaviour (ck8 step 43) while the hidden suite registered 26 regressions from the new requirement check and first-run message. Throwaway probes in /tmp were frequent early, including comparing its YAML parser against PyYAML (ck2 step 16) and the real docker client (ck6 step 9). Most first failures stem from details the spec leaves open, such as table schema (ck5 step 10), file locations (ck7 step 29) and key names; one is unfinished wiring (site create never calls the ck6 volume code) and one is a cross-module mismatch between stdin decoding and the site create synopsis (ck3 step 16).
